title: Viking Ships at Sunrise
author: Mary Pope Osborne
desc: Jack and Annie meet kind monks and a giant sea serpent in Ireland! 杰克和安妮在爱尔兰遇见善良的修士和巨大的海中巨蛇！

q.en: In ancient Ireland, on what kind of place does the magic tree house land?
q.zh: 在古代爱尔兰，魔法树屋降落在什么样的地方？

options.en: a cliff on a small island off the coast
options.zh: 海边一座小岛上的一处悬崖

options.en: a busy marketplace in the middle of a large Roman city
options.zh: 一座大罗马城市正中央热闹的集市

explain.en: The tree house lands in a lone tree on a cliff above the ocean, on a small island off the coast of Ireland where a monastery stands.
explain.zh: 树屋停在海边一座小岛悬崖上的一棵孤树上，岛上一座修道院矗立在那里。

q.en: Who is the friendly monk with a round red face who helps Jack and Annie?
q.zh: 那位圆脸红润、帮助杰克和安妮的友善修士是谁？

explain.en: A bald monk with a round red face and a fringe of hair lowers a rope to help them up the cliff and welcomes them as Brother Patrick.
explain.zh: 一位光头、圆脸红润、留着一圈头发的修士放下绳子帮他们爬上悬崖，他自称帕特里克兄弟。

q.en: According to Brother Patrick, why are the prows of Viking ships carved like a serpent's head?
q.zh: 根据帕特里克修士的说法，维京船的船头为什么被雕成蛇头的样子？

options.en: it is a sign of peace
to help the heavy warship sail faster through storms
options.zh: 为了让沉重的战船在风暴中航行得更快

options.en: to honor the great sea god Neptune
options.zh: 为了敬奉伟大的海神尼普顿

options.en: it stands for their fierce, cold-blooded ways
options.zh: 它代表他们凶猛冷酷的本性

explain.en: Brother Patrick says the prows are carved like a serpent's head, which stands for the Vikings' fierce, cold-blooded ways. They are called serpent ships.
explain.zh: 帕特里克兄弟说船头被雕成蛇头，代表维京人凶猛冷酷的本性。这些船被称为“巨蛇船”。

q.en: What shape are the stone huts of the Irish monastery where the monks live and work?
q.zh: 爱尔兰修道院里修士们生活和工作用的石头小屋，是什么形状的？

explain.en: The monastery has six stone huts shaped like giant beehives, used for baking, sleeping, spinning cloth, cobbling sandals, and the library.
explain.zh: 修道院有六座像巨大蜂巢的石头小屋，用来烤面包、睡觉、纺布、补鞋，还有藏书。

q.en: How does the old monk Brother Michael make his beautiful books?
q.zh: 老修士迈克尔兄弟是怎样制作那些漂亮的书卷的？

options.en: by printing them with carved wooden blocks and special ink
options.zh: 用雕刻木版和特制墨汁印刷

options.en: on sheepskin with goose quill pens
by carving each letter into stone
options.zh: 把每个字母刻进石头里

options.en: by painting them onto rolls of silk

explain.en: Brother Michael says he writes on sheepskin using goose quill pens, and his paints are made of earth and plants. His book is decorated with red and blue jewels.
explain.zh: 迈克尔兄弟说他用鹅毛笔在羊皮上书写，颜料用泥土和植物制成。他的书还装饰着红蓝宝石。

q.en: When there was no wind, how many rowers did the smallest Viking warships have?
q.zh: 在没有风的时候，最小的维京战船上有多少名桨手？

explain.en: Jack reads that Viking warships rowed with oars when there was no wind: the smallest ships had four rowers and the largest had as many as thirty-two.
explain.zh: 杰克读到，没有风时维京战船用桨划行：最小的船有四名桨手，最大的多达三十二名。

q.en: What giant sea creature pushes Jack and Annie's ship through the storm to the shore?
q.zh: 是什么巨大的海中生物，推着杰克和安妮的船穿过风暴回到岸边？

options.en: a huge sea serpent named Sarph
options.zh: 一条叫萨尔夫的巨大海蛇

options.en: an enormous giant blue whale of the deep
options.zh: 深海里那条体型惊人的巨型蓝鲸
一只爱玩耍的淡水海豚

explain.en: A giant sea serpent with green scales pushes their ship to shore. Morgan later names it Sarph, a Celtic creature linked to the Milky Way.
explain.zh: 一条长着绿色鳞片巨大海蛇把他们的船推回岸边。摩根后来称它为萨尔夫，是与银河有关的凯尔特生物。

q.en: According to Morgan's facts, what does the word "Vikings" mean?
q.zh: 根据摩根补充的知识，“维京人”这个词是什么意思？

explain.en: Morgan's facts say the word Vikings means "fighting men" and included Danes, Norwegians, and Swedes. They later became traders and craftsmen too.
explain.zh: 摩根补充说，“Vikings（维京人）”意思是“战士”，包括丹麦人、挪威人和瑞典人。他们后来也成了商人和工匠。

q.en: Brother Patrick says civilization hides "on top of our lonely island." What place is he talking about?
q.zh: 帕特里克修士说文明“藏在我们孤独小岛的高处”。他说的是哪个地方？

explain.en: In the largest beehive hut, monks read, play chess, and make books. Brother Patrick calls it where civilization hides on their lonely island.
explain.zh: 在最大的蜂巢小屋里，修士们读书、下棋、做书。帕特里克兄弟说，那就是文明藏在他们孤独小岛上的地方。

q.en: Morgan says that after they settled down, the Vikings became more than warriors. What did they become?
q.zh: 摩根说维京人安定下来后，不再只是战士。他们后来还成了什么，为文明作出贡献？

options.zh: 宏伟石制大教堂的建造者

explain.en: Morgan says the Vikings were "settling men" as well as fighters; they became traders exchanging goods and expert craftsmen who added to civilization.
explain.zh: 摩根说维京人既是“战士”也是“定居者”；他们成了以物易物的商人和技艺精湛的工匠，为文明作出贡献。
